# iaas_microvm_connector (Resource)

Manages a GitHub App or GitLab integration that launches MicroVMs for provider jobs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iaas_microvm_connector" "github" {
  kind                = "github_app"
  name                = "github-actions"
  git_source_id       = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  hypervisor_group_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  plan_id             = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  image_id            = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
  labels              = ["self-hosted", "linux", "x64"]
  max_concurrent      = 4
  enabled             = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `kind` (String) Connector kind: github_app or gitlab_runner.
- `name` (String) Connector display name.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector accepts jobs. Enabling requires a location and plan.
- `git_source_id` (String) Installed owned GitHub App source UUID. Required for github_app.
- `gitlab_run_untagged` (Boolean) Whether GitLab jobs without tags may use this connector.
- `gitlab_token` (String, Sensitive) Write-only GitLab runner authentication token. Required when creating gitlab_runner.
- `gitlab_url` (String) GitLab base URL. Required for gitlab_runner.
- `hypervisor_group_id` (String) Location UUID used for launched MicroVMs.
- `image_id` (String) Ready image UUID used for launched MicroVMs.
- `labels` (List of String) GitHub labels or GitLab tag list.
- `max_concurrent` (Number) Maximum concurrent jobs. The server defaults to 1.
- `plan_id` (String) Plan UUID used for launched MicroVMs.
- `warm_count` (Number) Warm MicroVM count. The server defaults to 0.

### Read-Only

- `billing_suspended_at` (String) Timestamp when billing suspended this connector, if any.
- `id` (String) UUID assigned to the connector.
- `state` (String) Connector readiness state: needs_plan or ready.
